route_assumptions: One-way constant latency assumptions, not measurements. Recorded direct Taiwan Binance receipt is treated as Tokyo->Taiwan proxy. Local Ohio feed latency defaults to zero. Both feed timestamps are translated before reordering all events.
binding_assumption: Recover oracle transaction writers locally; learn delegated writer/feed bindings only from matching pushed FeedUpdated arrivals. Unknown writers cannot modify decision state until confirmed. Word ID alone is not a global feed identity.
calldata_clock: Earliest recorded local relay receipt, mapped to recorder monotonic time
execution_delay_definition: Ohio signal receipt plus 20 ms machine-to-chain latency; immediate execution on arrival is assumed. Additional compute, signing, or sequencing queue delay is not modeled.
initial_inventory_assumption: Same token balance across routes: 500 / 139.91 (Taiwan initial Binance ask), floored to 18 decimals. All routes use common initial bid mark 139.90 USDG; actual acquisition cost is unknown.
